brief_summary: To compare the efficacy and effect on glycemic control of Dulaglutide versus Liraglutide in obese Type 2 diabetic adolescents using metformin
brief_title: Dulaglutide Versus Liraglutide in Obese Type 2 Diabetic Adolescents Using Metformin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
* Obese
* Taking metformin
* Male or female

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non obese
* Not taking metformin
* Taking other injectable diabetic medications

official_title: Dulaglutide Versus Liraglutide in Obese Type 2 Diabetic Adolescents Using Metformin: Results From a Randomized Double Blinded Clinical Trial
